_help: Test Your Product prices and tiers (US dollars only). deposit: share paid upfront (used only when a tier has no depositUsd). depositUsd: the exact deposit for a tier. popularLabel: the badge on the tier marked popular. guarantee: the line under the prices. foundingOffer: the founding banner; set left to how many slots are still open (the banner hides at 0, and the discounted deposits stop being sold), discount is the share taken off the deposit (0.4 = 40%). testerShare: share of the price paid out to testers, split between the testers whose work is approved. testerCoins: site coins (no cash value) for each approved test. minRank: the rank a player needs to become a tester (from data/ranks.json). was / wasDeposit: the price and deposit before the sale (shown crossed out); sale: the tag next to the prices. To end the sale, put was back into price and wasDeposit into depositUsd, and remove was, wasDeposit and sale. The founding offer is off while the sale runs (they would add up).
depositLine: Fully refunded if we decline your project after vetting.
